item.tib: gshen rab kyis phrin las bco brgyad kyi don bstan pa'i mdo g.yung drung klong rgyas cho ga
item.coloph: 'gro ba'i don du phrin las bco brgyad kyi bon bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o …
item.note: this seems to be a chapter (chapter no. 14, apparently) extracted from the gzer mig, to which ritual directions have been added. the 14th chapter of the gzer mig does have the same title.
